shop_paused: 拼豆小店尚在开发，暂不开放购买。
The little shop is still in development and is not open for purchases.
reservation_group_limit: 同行人数超过当前每组上限，请调整人数或联系店主。
Your group exceeds the current limit. Adjust the number or contact the host.
reservation_policy_conflict: 新规则与已确认预约冲突，请先联系客人调整已有安排。
These rules conflict with a confirmed visit. Arrange changes with the guest first.
reservation_outside_window: 目前仅接受未来两周的预约，请重新选择日期。
Please choose a date within the next two weeks.
reservation_interval_unavailable: 这个时段无法安排，请选择其他至少两小时的时段。
This time cannot be arranged. Choose another interval of at least two hours.
reservation_in_past: 这个开始时间已过去，请重新选择。
This start time has passed. Please choose another.
reservation_day_end: 全天体验需在当天可预约时段结束时结束。
A day visit ends at the end of that day's available hours.
reservation_session_missing: 请重新加载时间表后恢复提交。
Reload the timetable before recovering this submission.
reservation_request_changed: 无法核对原提交，请联系店主查询，避免重复预约。
We could not verify the original submission. Contact the host to avoid a duplicate.
reservation_not_found: 无法读取这份预约，请使用提交时的浏览器，或联系店主查询。
Open this reservation in the browser used to submit it, or contact the host.
reservation_confirmation_conflict: 此时段已有已确认预约，请先处理重叠安排。
A confirmed reservation overlaps this time. Resolve the overlap first.
reservation_not_confirmed: 请先确认预约，再标记为已完成。
Confirm the reservation before marking it complete.
invalid_reservation_time: 请选择整点或半点时间。
Choose a time on the hour or half hour.
checkout_not_open: 网上购买即将开放，请稍后再来。
Online purchases will open soon. Please check back.
slot_unavailable: 这个时段的座位不足或已过期，请重新选择。
This time is no longer available. Please choose another.
stock_unavailable: 有商品库存不足，请调整数量。
An item has insufficient stock. Please update the quantity.
product_unavailable: 有商品暂未上架，请将它移出购物车。
An item is unavailable. Please remove it from your bag.
price_changed: 价格已更新，请核对新的金额后再次结账。
Prices have changed. Review the updated total before paying.
version_conflict: 其他操作已更新这份资料，请刷新后再保存。
This was updated elsewhere. Refresh before saving.
capacity_below_reservations: 人数上限不能低于已经确认或暂留的座位数。
Capacity cannot be lower than existing reservations.
stock_below_holds: 库存不能低于付款中的暂留数量。
Stock cannot be lower than the quantity held for payment.
order_not_found: 无法读取订单，请用下单的浏览器打开。
Please open this order in the browser you used to purchase.
request_changed: 这次结账内容已变化，请刷新购物车。
Checkout details changed. Please refresh your bag.
order_not_paid: 订单尚未完成付款，不能标记为已交付。
This order has not been paid and cannot be fulfilled.
order_amount_limit: 本单金额超出在线支付范围，请分开购买。
This order exceeds the online limit. Please split your purchase.
content_placeholders_required: 请保留原文中的动态占位符，例如 {v0}。
Keep the original dynamic placeholders, such as {v0}.
content_invalid_media: 图片地址或格式不正确，请重新上传。
This image could not be used. Upload it again.
image_invalid: 请选择有效的 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片。
Choose a valid JPG, PNG or WebP image.
image_too_large: Images must be 12 MB or smaller.
import_url_not_supported: 请粘贴小红书的帖子分享链接。
Paste a Xiaohongshu post share link.
import_source_unavailable: 小红书暂未提供可读取的完整内容。请从帖子重新复制分享链接后重试，或手动添加图文。
Xiaohongshu did not provide the complete post. Copy a fresh share link and retry, or add the text and images manually.
import_browser_login_required: 小红书要求登录或验证，暂时无法读取完整文章，未创建草稿。请使用可打开的帖子分享链接，或手动添加图文。
Xiaohongshu requires sign-in or verification. The complete post could not be read, so no draft was created. Use a readable post share link, or add the text and images manually.
import_author_mismatch: 这篇帖子不属于小狗双吉账号，请检查链接。
This post is not from the Xiaogou Shuangji account. Check the link.
import_incomplete: 原帖信息不完整，未生成日记。请重新分享链接或手动添加。
The original post was incomplete. No story was created. Share it again or add it manually.
journal_already_exists: 这篇日记已经导入，请在列表中选择它继续编辑。
This story is already imported. Select it in the list to edit.
journal_before_cutoff: 这里只收录 2026 年 6 月 24 日之后的帖子。
Only posts after June 24, 2026 are included.
journal_english_required: 发布前请补充英文标题与正文，可以使用“生成英文”。
Add an English title and body before publishing. You can use Generate English.
journal_invalid_date: 请填写有效的原帖日期。
Enter a valid original post date.
block_confirmed_conflict: 此时段有已确认预约，不能直接封闭。请先处理对应预约。
This time contains a confirmed reservation. Resolve that reservation before blocking the time.
block_invalid_date: 请选择今天至未来一年内的日期。
Choose a date between today and one year from now.
block_not_found: 这个封闭时段已被其他窗口移除，请刷新。
This block was already removed. Refresh the list.
translation_unavailable: 英文翻译暂不可用，中文和图片已保留，可以手动填写英文。
English translation is unavailable. Chinese text and images are safe; you can enter English manually.
translation_failed: 本次翻译未完成，原文保持不变。请重试或手动填写英文。
Translation did not finish. The original is unchanged. Retry or enter English manually.
translation_rate_limit: 本小时的翻译次数已用完，请稍后重试。
The hourly translation limit was reached. Try again later.
import_rate_limit: 本小时导入次数已用完，请稍后重试。
The hourly import limit was reached. Try again later.
journal_incomplete: 发布前请补充中文标题、正文和至少一张图片。草稿已经保存。
Add a Chinese title, body and at least one image before publishing. Your draft is saved.
content_invalid_price: 请输入不超过两位小数的非负价格，中英文价格应一致。
Enter a non-negative price with up to two decimal places. Both language values must match.
image_format_unsupported: 此图片格式暂不支持，请导出为 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 后重试。
This image format is unsupported. Export as JPG, PNG or WebP and retry.
image_original_format_unsupported: 日记原图请使用 JPG、PNG 或 WebP。
Use JPG, PNG or WebP for journal originals.
image_heic_unsupported: 这是 HEIC／HEIF 图片，请先在照片应用中导出为 JPG，再上传。
This is a HEIC/HEIF image. Export it as JPG in your photo app before uploading.
server_error: 服务暂时未完成操作，修改仍在，请稍后重试。
The service could not finish this action. Your edits are safe. Please retry.
import_queue_full: 还有导入正在处理，请稍后重试。
Other imports are still running. Please retry shortly.
import_job_not_found: 未找到这次导入记录，请重新粘贴分享链接。
This import record was not found. Paste the share link again.
import_interrupted: 服务更新中断了导入，原有日记未改动，请重试。
A service update interrupted the import. Existing stories are unchanged. Please retry.
reservation_contact_required: 首次预约请填写称呼和联系方式。
Please provide your name and contact details for your first visit.
reservation_offer_invalid: 此套餐需选择两人、连续四小时，请重新选择。
This offer requires two guests and four consecutive hours. Please select again.
reservation_offer_expired: 此套餐不适用于所选日期，请选择其他体验。
This offer is unavailable for the selected date. Choose another experience.
reservation_offer_changed: 套餐信息已更新，请核对后重新提交。
The offer has changed. Review it before submitting again.
reservation_patch_duration: 布贴DIY每次固定预约1小时，请重新选择到店时间。
Patch DIY bookings must be exactly 1 hour. Please choose your arrival time again.
